title: No 5 Points on 2-plane in [N]^d
exact_target: How large can a subset of a high-dimensional integer grid be if every affine two-plane contains at most four of its points?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 135 (GREEN-047). CC BY 4.0.
Ben Green, \emph{100 Open Problems}, maintained author collection, Problem 74 and its comments, accessed 7 October 2026.
